propositions: Cloud and Data Center handle rich text differently (ADF JSON vs wiki markup), requiring a Protocol abstraction to unify the two paths behind a common interface

The four-operation codec contract (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) must remain separate because callers compose them differently: _fit_description uses both fit and normalize, while sanitize_description uses only fit
AdfCodec must live in adapters/jira/ not jira_family/, otherwise jira_family/ would import location-pinned Cloud modules, violating J2's import contract test

A single shared implementation of map_fields_to_remote must exist in adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py, accepting the codec as a constructor dependency, eliminating the duplicate Cloud vs DC paths from PR #120

WikiTextCodec truncates at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767 chars) with a consistent marker (' … [truncated by reconciler]'), matching adf.py's marker wording so both deployments show identical truncation signals
Cloud codec output must equal J1's pinned oracle values to prove behavior preservation, and decode_inbound(None) must return '' for both implementations
